referenceSources.title: Ford GT40 Mk2 & Mk2B '67 Guide — Supercar Nostalgia
referenceSources.description:
A dark gray Ford Sierra Sapphire RS Cosworth stands alone on a flat asphalt surface beneath a clear, pale blue sky. The four-door sedan is captured in a front three-quarter view, showcasing its aerodynamic bodywork, alloy wheels, and subtle rear spoiler. Amber turn signals and integrated fog lights accentuate the sporty front fascia.

The isolated setting emphasizes the car’s clean lines and performance heritage. With its distinctive Sapphire RS Cosworth badging and period-correct styling, this late-1980s model exemplifies Ford’s focus on combining everyday practicality with motorsport-inspired design.
